verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਤਾਰ ਕੈ ਸਨੇਹ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤਾ ਹੁਇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤ ਲੀਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: naar kai bhataar kai saneh patibrataa hui gursikh ek Tek patibrat leen hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a wife is considered faithful who lives life in the love of her husband. So does an obedient Sikh of the Guru take refuge of one Guru-God Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਬਾਦ ਅਉ ਸੰਬਾਦ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤਾ ਹੁਇ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਨ ਕਾਨ ਸਿਖ ਦੀਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: raag naadh baadh aau sa(n)baadh patibrataa hui bin gur sabadh na kaan sikh dheen hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a husband enjoys the subject of mode of singing musical instruments and other conversation, so does a Sikh in the service of the Guru talks and listens nothing other than the sound of the divine words of the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਸਰਬੰਗ ਹੇਰੇ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤਾ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ ਨ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: roop ra(n)g a(n)g saraba(n)g here patibrataa aan dhev sevak na dharasan keen hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a faithful wife admires the good looks, colour and beauty of all limbs of her husband, so does a devoted Sikh neither is the follower of any god nor proceeds to see any. Other than one True Guru, the form of True Master, he looks at no one else.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਜਨ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਗਉਨ ਕਰੈ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤਾ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸਥਾਨ ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੀਨ ਹੈ ॥੪੪੯॥
verses.translit_en: sujan kuTa(n)b gireh gaun karai patibrataa aan dhev sathaan jaise jal bin meen hai ||449||

en.bdb: Just as a faithful wife lives amongst close relatives and goes nowhere else; so does the Sikh of the Guru live in the court of the True Guru and assembly of His devotees. Leaving to him is like a fish dying after leaving water. (449)
